title: Bound the connected Ramanujan phase-linear flat subclass absolutely
statement: For connected XOR-Cayley bases put W=kerG,Q=sum_(i<j)wi wj. Q|W=0 makes W totally isotropic for J+I of rank d or d-1, so k=rankG>=(d-1)/2. The dimension-k binary character code has minimum nonzero weight D>=(d-2sqrt(d-1))/2; a trivial bipartite all-ones word does not weaken this minimum. Hamming balls of radiusfloor((D-1)/2) are disjoint. For d>=256 this radius>=ceil(3d/16); binom(d,r)>=2^(d H2(r/d))/(d+1)>2^(2d/3)/(d+1), using (3^3*13^13)^3<2^160. Together with k>=(d-1)/2 this contradicts2^k*ballvolume<=2^d. Hence d<256 and n=2^k<=2^255. This Root complete correction applies ONLY to CONNECTED RAMANUJAN XOR-Cayley PHASE-LINEAR FLAT signings. It neither bounds arbitrary sharp/flat signings nor invalidates the infinite Walsh/Paley dense families.
